title: Sales Manager
must_have: 3+ years of experience in business sales
text:
Sales Manager
Tapti Industries | Full-time | Hybrid, India

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are hiring a sales manager to join our business sales team. You will work with cross-functional partners and own outcomes end to end.

MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS:
- Client Presentations
- CRM
- B2B Sales
- Account Management
- Sales Forecasting
- 3+ years of experience in business sales

NICE-TO-HAVE:
- Pipeline Management
- Negotiation
- Tender Responses
- Channel Partnerships

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Drive distributor network expansion with measurable outcomes.
- Drive mid-market segment launch with measurable outcomes.
- Drive enterprise accounts in the western region with measurable outcomes.
